announce_join_leave.description: Sets if the conference recording when a member joins or leaves will be played (yes/no).

silence_threshold.description: The time, in milliseconds, that silence needs to be present in the user’s sound stream before the system can consider it to be in fact silent and close the audio (allowed values are 2000, 2100, 2200, 2300, 2400, 2500, 2600, 2700, 2800, 2900 or 3000).
